import os,stat,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/qianqi/work/hepta-runtime-d1-c1-sealed-staging-01')
rows=[]
for rel in ('','x230','x230/c1-tools-01','x230/c1-tools-01/reference','mac'):
 p=root/rel
 entries=[]
 for name in sorted(os.listdir(p)):
  s=os.lstat(p/name)
  entries.append({'name':name,'mode':oct(stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)),'bytes':s.st_size,'uid':s.st_uid,'nlink':s.st_nlink,'kind':'file' if stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) else 'directory' if stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode) else 'symlink' if stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode) else 'other'})
 rows.append({'relative_directory':rel,'entries':entries})
print(json.dumps({'read_only':True,'root':str(root),'directories':rows},sort_keys=True))
